latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset was gathered between 2017 and 2018 for as part of the "First-in-human evaluation of [ 11 C]PS13, 
a novel PET radioligand, to quantify cyclooxygenase-1 in the brain". This dataset consists of 16 subjects and their
imaging data, including blood data.

For more details about the paper, authors, or dataset see the attached dataset_description.json or the participants.tsv.
